summary: Capiz 2nd District representative with 12 principal-authored bills. Authored marriage and family equality, front-of-package food warnings, PWD offices and a hospital upgrade; co-authored the national minimum wage, violence against women in politics and child online safety.
caveat: Gender and family equality is one issue, so social values are unscored. Child online safety bill direction not reviewed.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored front-of-package warning labels (-2) and PWD offices (-1); co-authored national minimum wage (-2). No tax, ownership or privatization evidence.
